012221211200201000111102202 - ASI: 21

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  01 = 0 * 1
  02 = 0 * 2
  11 = 1 * 1
  12 = 1 * 2
  21 = 2 * 1
  002 = 0 * 02
  011 = 0 * 11
  012 = 0 * 12
  202 = 2 * 02
  221 = 2 * 21
  00011 = 00 * 011
  02202 = 02 * 202
  12002 = 12 * 002
  012221 = 012 * 221
  0100011 = 01 * 00011
  1102202 = 11 * 02202
  2112002 = 21 * 12002
  0122212112002 = 012221 * 2112002
  01000111102202 = 0100011 * 1102202
  012221211200201000111102202 = 0122212112002 * 01000111102202
